author: The Current
description:
Niko Kapetan talks about how he came to embrace the idea of a tour record
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Chicago band Friko recently visited The Current to talk to host Zach McCormick about their new album, "Something Worth Waiting For," which released April 24, 2026, on @atorecords.

During the interview, Zach notes how the album seems to have been influenced by the band's experience on the road. Friko lead vocalist Niko Kapetan talks about how he had previously been resistant to writing a tour record, but ultimately embraced it. "It's unavoidable," he says, and describes how touring provides life experiences unlike anything else. Watch the full interview clip above.

title: Friko talk about making a road album with "Something Worth Waiting For"
